name: dev-team-office
author: Fabián Muñoz (https://github.com/fmunoztorrent)
description: A live pixel-art office for your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi…): every subagent is a character of a development team. Zero dependencies, MCP server included.

scripts.build: deno compile --no-check --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-run --include public --include integrations --include teams --include skills --output dist/dev-team-office bin/dev-team-office.js
scripts.build:mac-x64: deno compile --no-check --target x86_64-apple-darwin --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-run --include public --include integrations --include teams --include skills --output dist/dev-team-office-x64 bin/dev-team-office.js
